lede: Troy carries the stronger underlying team rating — +2.0 against +0.1, a 1.8-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Utah State -3.7 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Utah State winning 60% of simulations.
The position-group comparison shows where the separation comes from: the widest measured gap is depth, where Utah State leads Troy by 91 places nationally.
Data confidence on this matchup is 77% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
